description: Figure 3(a) is a line plot that shows the Bit-per-Character (BPC) on the validation dataset during the training phase reported for Mistral [27] across the three routing mechanisms. The x-axis represents the training steps, which are plotted on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^0 to 10^10. The y-axis represents the BPC, which is also plotted on a logarithmic scale ranging from 1.25 to 2.25. There are two lines in the plot, one representing the SMoE with the Balancing Loss and the other representing the StableMoE. The SMoE line starts at a BPC of approximately 2.25 and decreases steadily to a BPC of approximately 1.25 as the training steps increase. The StableMoE line starts at a BPC of approximately 2.25 and decreases more gradually to a BPC of approximately 1.25 as the training steps increase. The plot is used to compare the performance of the two routing mechanisms in terms of BPC during the training phase.
